notes:
SWIT QB Companion 2.0.0-beta.117

Compare again now re-reads the statement as well, using the app’s current reader, so fixes to a bank’s layout apply to statements you’ve already compared.
Lines are corrected in place, so anything matched, linked (“Entered here”) or recorded from them stays.
The comparison’s dates and balances update too, unless you typed them in yourself.
It tells you how many lines were corrected. If the statement now reads as a different number of lines, it asks you to remove the comparison and upload the statement again.
ScotiaConnect “Current Day Account Activity”: the period is now that day only, not the whole month to date.
